criteria.requirement: Make CharsetMatch retain immutable payload bytes so caller bytearray mutation cannot diverge raw bytes from cached text. Add charset_normalizer.buffers.from_buffer(buffer, **options) for continuous buffer protocol input, explicitly snapshot non-bytes, preserve caller view ownership and return matches/copied/nbytes. Reject noncontiguous/released/nonbuffer inputs clearly, support empty/read-only/writable buffers and delegate detection options to actual from_bytes. Do not promise universal zero-copy decoding or change existing immutable bytes results.
